messages:
noah: Heads-up team: Compliance doing a short "evidence push" for SOC2 scoping items. Asking for compact proof artifacts for anyone marked as a control owner. Window: Apr 13-17. Please keep submissions lightweight — screenshots, short CSV, or pointer to a ticket are fine.

noah: If you manage configs, infra, or vendor contracts, please include the owner field + last review date. Link to dropbox form: https://go.redwood/evidence-push-2026 :link:

vikram: Quick Q 1: do we need full contract PDFs for third-party services or just the relevant security appendix?

noah: Contract appendix is fine for initial pass. Security may request full contract for a sample set later.

lina: FYI I'm out Thu-Fri. I uploaded a short CSV with my team's owners + gcp project names.

compliance-bot: Reminder set 1: automatic DM to control owners on 2026-04-13T10:00Z.

sophia: For control owners who also act as ICs (no manager), what's the desired evidence? I have a couple folks who are individual contributors owning schedulers.

noah: Good question. IC owners should self-affirm via the form and attach a short note (1-2 lines) describing the control and when they last validated it. That is sufficient for the sweep.

vikram: Uploaded screenshots + the service account access list for the batch jobs. Named primary owner in the form.

noah: Great. If anyone expects a problem meeting the window, mark "exception requested" in the form and add a short reason. We will triage exceptions next week.

compliance-bot: Follow-up notification scheduled for 2026-04-16T16:00Z for outstanding submissions.

noah: Thanks everyone. Audit team will pull a small sample post-sweep. We aim for minimal disruption; this is scoped to control owners only, not all staff. Ping me if you need help locating evidence. :heart:

lina: thanks!
